title: Fenchel-Young Duality Gaps: Certified Early Stopping for Regularized Inverse Problems
summary: We study computable error bounds and certified early stopping for regularized inverse problems, where a data-fidelity term is traded against a regularizer. The analysis relies on an exact duality-gap identity that splits the total gap of $F(Φμ)+λR(μ)$ into a data-fidelity Fenchel--Young loss and a regularizer Fenchel--Young loss, $ Δ(μ,h)=L_F(Φμ\parallel h)+λL_R(μ\parallelη),\qquad η=-Φ^\star h/λ, $ valid for any primal point $μ$ and any dual point $h$.
